notes: PM → PF invoice: made for every new (and changed) Parakh Fertilizer sales invoice with the same lorry no., L.R. no., transporter, driver phone (and courier/docket); if two PARAKH FERTILIZER buyers exist, the one with items is used; if it can't be made, a clear message says why, and the PF invoice shows its PM invoice or a 'Make PM → PF invoice' button. Rawana QR: the confirm date of the rawana is read and put as the date in Stock IN. Master → Suppliers: open / add a supplier in a window like a buyer, with its items — raw material, grade, HSN, purchase rate per MT and freight per MT; Stock IN fills the item, rate and freight from them.
